spirit:component.spirit:name: arty_ddr_rmsnorm_0_0
spirit:component.spirit:description: Streaming RMSNorm sum-of-squares and absmax int8 quantizer, bit-exact with the firmware's nq_core. Three passes at one element per cycle against the soft CPU's 32.05 + 18.02 cycles per element. AXI4 slave: the CDMA writes x and g, reads the int8 result; the CPU pokes n/start and reads back mx, ss and xs.
